candidate_requirements.requirement: Obtain contextual details of the hypoglycaemic episodes: symptom–glucose linkage, oral intake, insulin/exogenous insulin exposure, and timing relative to TMP-SMX restart.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Severe symptomatic low readings days 73–75 immediately follow prophylaxis change; context is needed to distinguish medication-related from other causes.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Focused hypoglycaemia history and medication reconciliation, including confirmation of any insulin or glucose-lowering exposure.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Proposed as the next clinical assessment at this decision point.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Seek appropriately timed biochemical confirmation (paired glucose with insulin/C-peptide, and relevant workup for non-medication causes) if a further episode occurs, without delaying acute treatment.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Non-contemporaneous C-peptide values cannot establish the cause of the lows; a critical sample during an episode is the discriminating test.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: A clinically appropriate critical sample during the next episode, plus baseline workup for alternative hypoglycaemia mechanisms as clinically indicated.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Proposed request to be carried out at the next episode or as clinically indicated.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Clarify the patient's current immunosuppression status (tacrolimus troughs, renal function trend) and any other glucose-affecting medications at the time of the episodes.
candidate_requirements.rationale: Tacrolimus and renal function influence hypoglycaemia risk and interpretation, and stable values were documented only at day 69.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Review of current medication list and recent tacrolimus/creatinine levels.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Proposed as part of the next clinical assessment.

candidate_requirements.requirement: Establish the response to changing prophylaxis (whether hypoglycaemia resolved after TMP-SMX was stopped again), if documented.
candidate_requirements.rationale: The vignette explicitly notes this information is not supplied; a dechallenge–rechallenge pattern would strongly inform the causal assessment.
candidate_requirements.acceptable_alternatives: Review of subsequent clinical records or planned observation after any prophylaxis change.
candidate_requirements.deadline: Proposed request at this decision point, subject to record availability.
